messages:
alex: Rolling out release rc4 in 3m. Change window 40m. Canary plan 10% -> 50%.

maria: watching p50/p95 and 5xx. will call quickstop if thresholds breach.

sanjay: quickstop gating: p95 > 350ms OR 5xx > 0.8% sustained 2x1m. also monitor token-cost spikes.

priya: prefer pin-and-drain to full revert. pin target v2026-03-14-hotfix-2; steps in runbook.

alex: deploy-bot, start canary rc4 region=us-east-1 weight=10%
deploy-bot: Canary started for 2026-03-21-rc4 · region=us-east-1 · weight=10% · canary_id=4312500001
deploy-bot: runbooks: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-quickstop · https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-pin

maria: small p50 blip, p95 still OK.

eng-oncall: available to execute quickstop/rollback. say "eng-oncall: execute quickstop".

alex: seeing rising tail latency on assistant completion, investigating. hold escalation for now.

sanjay: reminder pin command: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --reason "quickstop"` — RBAC details in runbook.

maria: p95 -> 430ms for ~35s, meeting quickstop criteria.

alex: initiating quickstop. eng-oncall please execute. I'll draft release note.

eng-oncall: execute quickstop now.

eng-oncall: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --force --origin canary-4312500001` — completed. Traffic pinned; canary drained.

deploy-bot: Canary 4312500001 quickstopped by eng-oncall. Traffic pinned to v2026-03-14-hotfix-2. Incident: https://internal.redwood/incidents/4312500001 · postmortem checklist attached.

priya: release note: "rc4 quickstopped due to elevated assistant p95; traffic pinned to stable version. Investigation ongoing." Uploading perf diffs.

alex: actions: 1) collect KV cache hit/miss, 2) reproduce in staging with prod prompt mix, 3) inspect kernel/quant changes. Assign owners in incident doc.

maria: starting perf captures and logs. Will post links. :thumbsup:

sanjay: runbook also documents fast-abort if pin fails: `deployctl abort --release 2026-03-21-rc4 --kill-relay` — only if pin can't be applied.

alex: locking changelog to prevent accidental re-rolls until RCA.

deploy-bot: Deploy window closed for 4312500001. Canary aborted and pinned.

priya: scheduling a 20m sync; adding timeline to incident doc.

eng-oncall: monitoring off-thread; ping for handoff.

alex: closing thread for now. Will reopen with RCA or safe re-release plan. :white_check_mark:
